title: room_playlist
description: Emitted by the plugin (since 1.6.0) with the playlist state stored on the room (the JMTP room property that set_room_playlist writes). Not host only: a guest's copy sends it too. Sent when the room's JMTP changes (the host's own write included), when the game joins a room, when the game takes over as host (before the race_reset host_takeover), and after session_started each time the controller connects. Outside a room, the one sent on connecting says in_room false, with state and age_ms null. See server-protocol.md, Room playlist and handover

in_room.description: Whether the game is in a Photon room

is_host.description: Whether this game is the room's host: the Photon master client

state.description: The room's JMTP property: an opaque string owned by the controller, as set_room_playlist stored it. null when the room has none, or outside a room. Anyone in a room can write its properties, so check it before acting on it

age_ms.description: How long ago the state was written, on the Photon server's clock: PhotonNetwork.ServerTimestamp minus the room's JMTPt, in wrapping 32-bit arithmetic. Each game's ServerTimestamp is its own estimate of the server's, so it can be a few milliseconds below zero. null when there is no state
